name: html-custom-iframe-unsafe-ambiguous
description: Rejects unsafe, ambiguous, credential-bound, and source-runtime-only custom iframe surfaces with explicit capability diagnostics instead of raw HTML.

source_reference.notes: Generic custom-element iframe hosts without a single safe portable destination.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
